args.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.zoneref AS site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sc.curerank) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        scanconservation sc
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS environmental_condition
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.environmental_condition
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions ec ON s.zoneregistry = ec.site_code;

events.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.zoneref AS site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sc.curerank) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        scanconservation sc
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS environmental_condition
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.environmental_condition
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions ec ON s.zoneregistry = ec.site_code;
